devServer.detect_hint: Preview this project from its running dev server (keeps hot reload working)

page.tagline: Point, describe, and watch the code catch up.
page.title: Design Tweak

preview.backend_did_not_answer: The app backend did not answer. If you just changed it, toggle Design Tweak off and on in the Apps page.
preview.needs_dev_server_title: This is a web app — it needs a dev server
preview.no_dev_script_in_package_json: No dev script found in package.json — start it yourself, then press Dev server below.
preview.no_html_entry: There is no HTML entry point to serve from disk, so it has to be built and served by its own dev server.
preview.nothing_answered_at: Nothing answered at {{url}}. Start the dev server for this project, then retry — or clear its URL to preview the files from disk instead.
preview.unbundled_entry: Its entry point is {{entry}} — TypeScript/JSX, which a browser cannot run. The files have to be built as they are served, so there is nothing to preview from disk.

projects.browse_or_type_path: Browse for a folder, or type its path
projects.no_app_selected: No web app selected. Pick one in the dropdown — switching is instant.

requests.delete_confirm: Delete Request {{number}}? Its comments are removed permanently — this cannot be undone.
requests.empty_for_app: No edit requests for {{name}} yet. Switch the preview to Edit mode, right-click an element, and describe the change. Comments collect into a request you send as a batch.
requests.empty_no_app: No web app connected. Pick one in the dropdown above — each app keeps its own requests, history, and chat session.

status.added_comment: Added {{label}} — {{n}} in Request {{number}}, not sent yet.
status.added_found_dev_server: Added {{name}} — found its dev server at {{url}}.
status.added_many_dev_servers: Added {{name}} — {{n}} dev servers match this folder, so none was assumed. Set one in the dropdown.
status.could_not_start_dev_server: Could not start the dev server.
status.dev_server_stopped: Dev server stopped — previewing from disk.
status.follow_up_added: Follow-up {{label}} added to Request {{number}} — not sent yet.
status.follow_up_origin_missing: Could not find that comment to follow up on.
status.no_dev_server_found: No dev server found for this folder — start it, or type the URL.
status.picker_unavailable: Picker unavailable ({{error}}) — type the path instead.
status.dispatch_failed_unconfirmed: Request {{number}} was sealed but delivery could not be confirmed ({{error}}). Checking the session — the list will update.
status.no_session_for_request: Request {{number}} is ready but this app has no folder, so there is no session to send it to. Set the app's folder, then send it from the list.
status.servers_match_folder: {{n}} servers match this folder ({{ports}}) — pick one.
status.using_running_dev_server: Using the dev server already running at {{url}}.

manifest.description: Visually select elements in your live app preview and turn them into scoped, source-mapped edit requests for the agent — like Figma comments, but for code.

common.accepted_body_unreadable: The server accepted the request, but its reply could not be read.
